definition: Vowpal Wabbit (VW) is an open-source fast online interactive machine learning system library and program developed originally at Yahoo!
details: Research, and currently at Microsoft Research. It was started and is led by John Langford. Vowpal Wabbit's interactive learning support is particularly notable including Contextual Bandits, Active Learning, and forms of guided Reinforcement Learning. Vowpal Wabbit provides an efficient scalable out-of-core implementation with support for a number of machine learning reductions, importance weighting, and a selection of different loss functions and optimization algorithms.

explainer.lead: Vowpal Wabbit is an open-source, fast online interactive machine learning library and program, originally developed at Yahoo! Research and currently at Microsoft Research. It matters for scalable out-of-core learning and interactive learning such as contextual bandits.

tiers.eli5: It's a fast learning tool built to handle huge streams of data without loading it all at once.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers use it for out-of-core training with importance weighting, reductions, and selectable loss functions and optimizers, plus contextual bandits and active learning; a pitfall is that its many options and reduction-based design demand careful configuration.
tiers.paperLevel: It is an efficient scalable out-of-core implementation supporting machine learning reductions, importance weighting, a selection of loss functions and optimization algorithms, and interactive learning including Contextual Bandits, Active Learning, and forms of guided Reinforcement Learning. It was started and is led by John Langford.

explainer.example: A system trains a contextual bandit model with Vowpal Wabbit on a large stream of interaction logs to choose actions online.
